title: Integrated Content Quality Review — Cognitive Level vs Difficulty Alignment
key_finding_s855: Cognitive Level ≠ Difficulty — these are independent dimensions that must be calibrated separately
review_scope: Pack C Sections C+D (350 items), post-S861/S862 upgrades

cognitive_distribution.note: Distribution estimates based on S861 pool scan + post-upgrade adjustments. Rotation clones inherited CL changes from edited seeds.

misalignment_findings.assessment: Moderate mismatch. The item tests judgment about performance evaluation design (high cognitive demand) but is labeled Moderate-Easy (DS=2). Upgraded from DS=1 to DS=2 in S862 — still potentially under-calibrated at DS=2 for Evaluate-level judgment.
misalignment_findings.recommendation: Consider DS=3 if future learner data shows higher-than-expected success rates.

misalignment_findings.assessment: Critical mismatch. The stem is a definition-match ('what approach is being used?' = 'The DuPont method'). This is Remember-level, labeled Analyze, with Difficult difficulty. This is the DL-031 pattern — definition-match with inflated difficulty and cognitive labels.
misalignment_findings.recommendation: Reclassify to Remember / Easy (DS=1). This is a false Analyze claim.

misalignment_findings.scope: CC-010 through CC-014 (DuPont ROI), CC-030 through CC-034 (cost center), CC-040 through CC-044 (investment center), CC-050 through CC-054 (benchmarking)
misalignment_findings.assessment: 20 items across 4 rotation groups. All are definition-match items labeled Understand or Apply. Actual cognitive demand is Remember (recognizing a definition). Difficulty is inflated by 1-2 points.
misalignment_findings.recommendation: Downgrade to Remember / Easy (DS=1). These items should NOT be counted in Analyze or Evaluate coverage metrics.

difficulty_progression_review.finding: Difficulty progression within the S861-upgraded items is coherent: each item received a DS adjustment consistent with the added cognitive complexity. FOH variance items (CC-060, CC-061, CC-064) went from DS=3 to DS=4, reflecting the multi-step interpretation layer added.
difficulty_progression_review.anomaly: DC-025 went DS=3→4 while DC-005 stayed at DS=3. Both require similar analytical depth (business judgment about costing method choice vs OH rate timing). DC-005's DS=3 may be slightly understated.
difficulty_progression_review.overall_gradient: The upgraded pool shows a reasonable difficulty gradient: DS=3 (moderate analytical items), DS=4 (complex multi-step interpretation), DS=2 (judgment-framework items with simpler fact patterns).

calibration_recommendations: Run a full-pool difficulty audit on all Pack C items using the S720 methodology (definition-match detection + DS recalibration)
Downgrade 20 definition-match items in Sections C+D from Understand/Apply → Remember (DS→1)
Consider upgrading DC-005 DS=3→4 to match DC-025's calibration
Flag CC-014 (false Analyze) for DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry

caqs_target_comparison.gap_assessment: Critical gap remains. Analyzed coverage doubled in S861 but is still ~13x below target. Evaluate coverage is effectively zero. These targets are structural, not achievable in a single wave.
